[Verse 1]
[D]There's a place up ahead
and I'm goin'
[A]just as fast as my feet
can fly [D]
Come away, come away
if you're goin',
[A]leave the sinkin' ship
behind. [D]

[Chorus]
[G]Come on the [D]risin' wind,
[A]we're
[G]goin' up [D]around the bend.
[A]
Ooh!

[Verse 2]
[D]Bring a song and a smile
for the banjo,
[A]better get while the
gettin's good, [D]
Hitch a ride to the end
of the highway
[A]where the neons
turn to wood. [D]

[Chorus]
[G]Come on the [D]risin' wind,
[A]we're
[G]goin' up [D]around the bend.
[A]
Oooh!

[Verse 3]
[D]You can ponder perpe-
tual motion,
[A]fix your mind on a cry-
stal day, [D]
Always time for a good
conversation,
[A]there's an ear for
what you say. [D]

[Chorus]
[G]Come on the [D]risin' wind,
[A]we're
[G]goin' up [D]around the bend.
[A]
Yeah!

big red tree, [D]

and I'm goin',
[A]come along, come along
with me. [D]
